candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a two-year-old with bilateral, painless jaw swelling, multilocular radiolucent lesions involving mandibular bodies, angles, rami, and maxillary tuberosities — classic presentation of cherubism. C001 names cherubism of mandible and maxilla, which is anatomically consistent and fully equivalent to the reference diagnosis 'cherubism'; the added anatomical detail is a harmless, record-supported qualifier.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cherubism with bilateral mandible and maxilla involvement matches the reference diagnosis of cherubism; the anatomical qualifier is consistent with the clinical record and does not introduce an incompatible subtype
